name: Advanced Laser Technology and Laser Based Instrumentation
description: Light matter interaction with semiclassical and quntum formulations, spontaneous emission, absorption, stimulated emission, emission broadening and line width, basic building blocks of laser, population inversion, rate equations, three-level and four level systems, Laser beam characteristics laser resonators, pumping schemes and cavity dynamics, cavity modes, cavity stability criteria, nonlinear light matter interaction and harmonic generation, Q-switching and mode locking, Different laser types, solid state lasers, diode lasers, gas lasers, fiber lasers and supercontinuum sources, frequency combs, recent advances in new-generation quantum cascade lasers and sub-hertz linewidth, specialized resonator based lasers, laser electronics and mechatronics for laser system development, AI/ML-driven schemes in laser based instrumentation, laser-based applications and metrology, advances in laser-based instrumentation for scientific and industrial applications, laser based instrumentation for biomedical diagnostics/treatment, laser based space and strategic applications, laser-assisted quantum enhanced applications.
